latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Volcengine AI Audio skill.

- Instantly enhance and clean audio in video/audio files via AI: remove background noise, improve voice clarity.
- Supports MP4, MOV, WAV, AAC uploads up to 500MB—no editing experience required.
- Fast cloud processing: upload, describe the result you want, and get clean audio in 30–60 seconds.
- Seamless user onboarding with automatic token setup (100 free credits, 7-day expiry).
- Includes workflows for upload, status, timeline preview, credits, and export.
- Robust error handling and user guidance for supported formats, file size, and plan limits.
